'''Dan Hultmark''' is a Swedish biologist currently Professor Emeritus, whose research focused on the mechanisms of [[Innate immune system|innate immunity]], using Drosophila as a model system, at [[Umeå University]] and an Elected Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellow/hultmark-dan |title=Dan Hultmark |publisher=aaas.org |accessdate=May 14, 2017 }}{{Dead link|date=January 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Dan Hultmark |url=https://www.umu.se/personal/dan-hultmark/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220514234431/https://www.umu.se/personal/dan-hultmark/ |archive-date=14 May 2022 |access-date=14 May 2022 |website=Umeå University |publisher=umu.se }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.molbiol.umu.se/english/research/researchers/dan_hultmark/ |title=Dan Hultmark |publisher=umu.se |accessdate=May 14, 2017 |archive-date=May 22, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170522111117/http://www.molbiol.umu.se/english/research/researchers/dan_hultmark/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Hultmark is also a member of the Drosophila 12 Genomes Consortium,<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Drosophila 12 Genomes Consortium |date=8 November 2008 |title=Evolution of genes and genomes on the Drosophila phylogeny |journal=Nature |doi=10.1038/nature06341 |pmid=17994087|doi-access=free |volume=450 |issue=7167 |pages=203–18 }}</ref> Tribolium Genome Sequencing Consortium.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tribolium Genome Sequencing Consortium |date=23 March 2008 |title=The genome of the model beetle and pest Tribolium castaneum |journal=Nature |volume=452 |issue=7190 |pages=949–955 |doi=10.1038/nature06784 |pmid=18362917|bibcode=2008Natur.452..949R |doi-access=free |hdl=11858/00-001M-0000-000F-D6B7-5 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
Hultmark received the Flormanska belöningen of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences (1994) and the [[:sv:Göran Gustafssons stiftelse|Göran Gustafsson Prize]] in Molecular Biology (1996).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Göran Gustafssons Stiftelser Pristagare |url=https://gustafssonsstiftelser.se/sid-4/stiftelse-2-kva/pristagare/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220515105423/https://gustafssonsstiftelser.se/sid-4/stiftelse-2-kva/pristagare/ |archive-date=15 May 2022 |access-date=15 May 2022 |website=Göran Gustafssons Stiftelser}}</ref> He  is a Distinguished Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science|American Association for The Advancement of Science]] section of biological sciences since 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AAAS Members Elected as Fellows |url=https://www.aaas.org/archives/aaas-international-news-notes |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220515095834/https://www.aaas.org/archives/aaas-international-news-notes |archive-date=15 May 2022 |access-date=15 May 2022 |website=American Association For The Advancement of Science}}</ref> Between 2009 and 2013 Hultmark was invited by the Academy of Finland to the Institute of Medical Technology, University of Tampere as a Finland Distinguished Professor.<ref>{{Cite web |title=New Fulbright Partner: University of Tampere |url=https://docplayer.fi/3236799-Fulbright-center-news.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220515104238/https://docplayer.fi/3236799-Fulbright-center-news.html |archive-date=15 May 2022 |access-date=15 May 2022 |website=Fulbright Center News}}</ref>
